description: Anonymous aggregate clinic statistics: total serves and condition counts. Conditions with fewer than 10 occurrences are withheld. Free, anonymous, no parameters — called with {}. It gauges swarm-level patterns (e.g. injection outbreaks) ahead of any decision on whether deeper checks are warranted; it carries no individual records, so anything about a specific agent pairs with qm_clinic_diagnose. Example: a call with no arguments returns total serves and counts by condition type.
name: qm_clinic_stats
